scores.evidence: Each section has a figure, table, code or check. textOnlyScreens is empty on both devices. The dr-table has 2 columns and reads cleanly at 390 px (mobile-jp-03/04). The cycle-flow mermaid uses flowchart TD with Japanese labels that stay legible on mobile (mobile-jp-16/17). The ex-settings and setup-settings-model code blocks show their highlighted lines clearly, and line 16 wraps with a hanging indent under its line number (mobile-jp-09).

The rhythm alternates well between lead text, steps, prompts and inline checks, and no screen is a wall of text. Two things add load. The 10 prerequisites render as one dense 9-line run of small grey text on mobile-jp-01. Desktop runs a median of 42 chars per line, above the 30–40 target, though that comes from the reader's measure.

All screens are in Japanese with no stray English UI text. English terms appear only as glosses (skill, hook, permission rule). The diagram has a caption and a full Japanese alt. Inline code chips stay whole and readable at 390 px (mobile-jp-07, mobile-jp-12). Contrast is fine, and nothing is hidden under the top or bottom bars.

niceToHave: ex-steps: the step titles carry circled numbers that repeat the reader's step badge, so mobile and desktop show '1 ① CLAUDE.mdを短く書く' (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, pages/desktop-jp-04.png). Remove ①–⑤ from the titles and refer to them as 手順1・2 / 手順3・4 in ex-b1, ex-prompt-claude-md and ex-prompt-skill.

lesson (prerequisites): the 10 entries render as one dense block of small grey text on the first mobile screen (pages/mobile-jp-01.png). Shorten it to something like '第2〜8回・第10回' plus the two practical prerequisites.
self-check-list (sc-safety): 'git push' is plain text in the label and breaks across lines at 390 px as 'git / push' (pages/mobile-jp-22.png). Rephrase it as 'pushの確認ルール', or keep the words together.

reader: in c-plan, the Shift+Tab and Ctrl+G key chips sit next to each other with no separator, so 'Tab Ctrl' reads as one combination (pages/mobile-jp-18.png, pages/desktop-jp-12.png). Put a gap or a separator such as '／' between combinations.
reader: desktop JP runs a median of 42 chars per line (680 px measure at 18.7 px), above the 30–40 target. Narrow the measure a little.
reader: the full-length PNGs are truncated at 16000 px and per-screen PNGs were used instead. The 13 failed /api/ requests are environment noise and are not counted as console errors.
summary: metrics.json is clean: no overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block or image errors, and no text-only screens. The table, diagram, code and checks stay readable at 390 px and 1440 px. No personal data appears on any screen. The most useful polish is to drop the circled numbers from the ex-steps titles, which double the step badges, and to shorten the dense prerequisites line on the first screen.
